fixed_model_rules: Original frozen C stream_kernel/instruction/memory_kind/build classify every recorded instruction/lane/address and full line touched by its width; do not remove stores/atomics or shorten epoch.
A line with any store or global atomic anywhere in the complete epoch is excluded; unresolved global/generic memory agents/opcodes poison positive certification.

Every later HtoD update excludes each affected whole128B line for the entire epoch, including neighbor sectors. Two recorded SGEMM HtoD commands are the initial prefix, not post-initialization updates.

Initial host copies and pre-epoch writes/writebacks must drain. Later uncovered clean/quiescent prefill is permitted by real native ownership/version/drain guards; no initial-only restriction is added.
Runtime certified-line writer/atomic/host contradiction must refuse before mutation; never silently drop certification after a transaction starts.

One canonical GPU global VA domain, no hidden virtual aliases/MMIO/external CPU/DMA/device writers and complete visible traced agents remain explicit closed-world assumptions, not independently proven physical facts.

Frozen trace-model replay, captured-source recapture and numerical-output reproduction remain distinct scopes. Unknown original capture/source/numeric assets are not invented universal gates revoking existing accepted trace-model results.
